clips.title: The story
paras: At the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, Cain Firesong guides Forsaken mages in the arcane. He trains them in Tirisfal Glades before sending advanced students to the Undercity for deeper study.

Cain Firesong teaches traditional arcane arts in Brill, where Forsaken mages begin their studies. Many Forsaken spellcasters turn to shadow or necromancy, but Cain keeps to the arcane. He mentors mages who set out from Deathknell. The Deathguards point visitors to the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern, where Cain can be found. They joke that he arrived too late to get a room.
Cain sends capable students onward when they outgrow their first studies in Tirisfal Glades. He directs them to Anastasia Hartwell, a master sorceress who lives in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
